mapper.select: WITH lock_guard AS ( SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(271828, CAST(MOD(#{userId}, 2147483647) AS integer)) AS locked ) SELECT 1 AS locked FROM lock_guard

SELECT id, user_id AS "userId", sign_date AS "signDate", reward_points AS "rewardPoints", continuous_count AS "continuousCount", cycle_day AS "cycleDay", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM user_sign_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sign_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sign_record ( user_id, sign_date, reward_points, continuous_count, cycle_day, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{signDate}, #{rewardPoints}, #{continuousCount}, #{cycleDay}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, sign_date) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: INSERT INTO user_point_account ( user_id, available_points, total_earned_points, total_used_points, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{rewardPoints}, #{rewardPoints}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), 1 ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET available_points = user_point_account.available_points + #{rewardPoints}, total_earned_points = user_point_account.total_earned_points + #{rewardPoints}, updated_at = NOW(), version = user_point_account.version + 1 RETURNING id, user_id AS "userId", available_points AS "availablePoints", total_earned_points AS "totalEarnedPoints", total_used_points AS "totalUsedPoints", version

SELECT id, user_id AS "userId", available_points AS "availablePoints", total_earned_points AS "totalEarnedPoints", total_used_points AS "totalUsedPoints", version FROM user_point_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
